gloss: page (of a newspaper); space in print

definitions.gloss: page; space in print (of a newspaper)
definitions.explanation: The printed pages of a newspaper, or the space on them given to an article or topic.

examples.japanese: {紙面|しめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: To appear prominently in the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紙面|しめん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{取|と}り{上|あ}げられた→取り上げる：02375_toriageru⟧。
examples.english: The incident was covered prominently in the next day's paper.

examples.japanese: {紙面|しめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Owing to limited space, part of the article has been omitted.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紙面|しめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{割|さ}く→割く：11820_saku⟧: to devote space (to a topic)
- {紙面|しめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ / {都合上|つごうじょう}: for reasons of space
- {紙面|しめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to make the headlines, to feature prominently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {誌面|しめん}: the pages of a magazine (same reading)
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: a screen, the on-screen equivalent
